verdict.rationale: Docs confirm self-hosting flexibility: remote daemons can run on cloud VM, workstation, or private-network machine, with CLI-based install/auth/launch, and the marketing site explicitly states you can 'bring your own compute...or run the HumanLayer stack on your workstation or remote workers.' Automation sessions can also run from CI/cron/scripts. However, there's no detailed self-hosting guide (Docker/container images, Helm charts, infra requirements) or independent confirmation of a fully self-hosted deployment. missing for 10: dedicated containerized/Docker deployment docs, independent verification of self-hosted production use, infra sizing/requirements.
